<!-- shot -->
### The four things

Here is what we do today, and I read them as we go:

- A message to their daughter about a winter visit.
- A checklist for the week, made from something Pat said out loud.
- Three questions to take to Friday's diabetes check.
- One thing to do outside the apartment this month.

That is the whole session.

<!-- shot -->
### List first

- This list stands before any spoken text on the screen.
- So it stays screen text.

The spoken line comes after it, and does not reach back.

<!-- shot -->
### No voice-over

- A list with no spoken voice-over on its screen.
- Stays screen text, and never reaches the script.
